description:
Department of Local Government - North Western Province - Notify convene the First Meeting of the Chilaw UC and 12 other Local Govt. Bodies in North -
 Western Province
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the scheduling of first meetings for the purpose of electing Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for various Local Government Institutions. It specifies dates, times, and venues for these electoral meetings, making it clearly related to electoral processes under the Local Government Institutes Election Ordinance, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
